scope: An original eight-space, roofless single-elevation survey wing in existing Cinder Hollow. Free recoverable inspection lens and one counterweight; optional inscription and caretaker account; an optical puzzle or maintenance route; protected plans; permanent inside return latch; physical report to Leonardo for 40 florins once and a visible Map House reading instrument. Not a guardian dungeon, procedural generator, upper gallery or MMO.
preservation: Full Vinci, original stories and 49 multilevel households, vehicles, roofs, cellars, Cinder Hollow encounters, Stillwater, Quarter accomplishments, Lantern Road satchel/NPC shops and optional Vesperfall page handoff remain. Save key svgn.leonardos-guild.v1 and outer version 2 are unchanged. No private manuscripts or sibling runtime edits.
delivery: Direct non-forced master updates. No new PR, staging branch or workflow. The existing Guild compositor verifier was extended. Concurrent Vesperfall work was retained.
controls: Start with Play Lantern Vault survey / keep my adventure, or use the chapter link then select an existing XR mode. Dismount using F on keyboard, Y on Xbox, or the existing XR vehicle action. I is the existing keyboard nearby-interaction action at the town gate and all new instruments. G also operates Vault instruments, but at the original town gate opens the household guide. Xbox interaction is normally X; tracked XR uses right B. Pause > Lantern Vault / tools and field notes selects survey equipment; Inventory also links it.

local_tests.journey_rules: Fresh rider, actual dismount, normal step movement and collision, original region gate actions, actual tool custody, physical return/report. No assigned actor coordinates, health, currency or quest stages in the two complete journeys. Separate rejection/unit fixtures are labelled.

completed_browser_journeys.verified: Ordinary keyboard/DOM movement and object use; labelled storage failure and retry; free tools; both distinct routes; protected plans; return latch; map; real WebGL eye attachments; synthetic hand-ray access to the real inventory; actual emulated-session end; physical return to Vinci; one report reward; visible Map House consequence; normal reload preservation.
completed_browser_journeys.source_note: DUNGEON-ADAPTATION.md was present in the pinned checkout/hash manifest and publicly verified but absent from the old local source archive; no runtime file was missing or different.
completed_browser_journeys.evidence_class: Real browser WebGL and real game actions with synthetic XR hardware. Not physical Quest or proof of general performance/visual quality.

visual_review.finding: The first-person inside-latch screenshot contained an oversized nearby instrument label obscuring the scene. Nonblank pixels did not establish good presentation. The low-resolution desktop captures also show crowded legacy HUD/sign layout.
visual_review.correction: vault-art.mjs now clears instrument banners within 3 game metres and entrance/approach signs within 4 metres while retaining approach labels, mechanisms and the existing close-range prompts. No layout, collision, save, controls or reward change.
visual_review.new_scene_graph_tests: Two actual-art fixtures fail before and pass after. Full local suite is 499 passes.
visual_review.fresh_browser_status: Not a completed gameplay/capture pass at receipt. The earlier 41 browser checks precede this final visibility-only correction.

limits: Physical Quest freezing, comfort, sustained performance, original aiming/audio feedback, broad visual polish and all old regression journeys are not certified. The survey is playable and published; unbuilt expansion and online systems remain explicitly future work.
